This workshop is designed to give instructors time, space, and practical tools to cultivate a reflective and responsive teaching practice. Participants will also learn from one another and from the Educational Development team, who will share a year-in-review and highlight emerging supports and trends to help guide teaching into the year ahead. That session will focus on preparing for the new academic term through collaborative learning and shared practice. This workshop will introduce our teaching and learning community to data collection and analysis strategies in qualitative research for SoTL. This workshop is intended for faculty, instructors, and educational staff who are new to SoTL or are interested in learning about qualitative research methods in pedagogical research.
